title_en: Interim Provisions of the State Council on the Calculation of Length of Service for Resignation and Retirement of State Organ Staff

articles.content_en: 9. The length of service of staff members shall be calculated on a yearly basis. When calculating severance pay and retirement pension, the remaining months after calculation on a yearly basis shall be counted as one year if exceeding six months, and shall be counted as half a year if equal to six months or less than six months.
